newsitem.title: USA: GPU willing to consider 3 Mile Island sale.
newsitem.headline: GPU willing to consider 3 Mile Island sale.

text.p: GPU Inc said Friday it was willing to consider selling its Three Mile Island nuclear plant after receiving inquiries about another one.
Last month, GPU said it would explore the possibility of selling or retiring its Oyster Creek Nuclear Generating Station.

The Oyster Creek plant can generate about 620 megawatts (MW) of power, while Three Mile Island plant can generate about 786 MW. A spokesman said Oyster Creek was worth about $700 million. He did not know how much the other plant would go for.

"Unlike Oyster Creek, the early retirement of TMI-1 (Three Mile Island) is not being considered because of lower operating costs at TMI-1," it said. "No decision about the sale of TMI, or the sale or early retirement of Oyster Creek, has been made."
The company said the Oyster Creek options would be part of a restructuring filing to be made with the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities in July.
Oyster Creek is owned by Jersey Central Power & Light Co and operated by GPU Nuclear Inc. Both are subsidiaries of GPU.
